headline: Iran Updates US and Israeli Targets, Ordering Response Without Borders
summary: Iran updated targets against the US and Israel, ordering an unrestricted geographical response. War escalation has forced major crude producers to begin refinery production cuts.
why: Iran is a major OPEC oil producer situated along the Persian Gulf, where geopolitical conflict directly threatens regional petroleum shipping and global energy supply lines.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Escalating military threats and refinery production cuts in the Middle East immediately raise global oil supply disruption risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heightened threats of military confrontation and reports of refinery production cuts triggered supply risk premiums in crude oil markets.
